figures.shows: Uranus total flux at 86 GHz measured with IRAM compared with the ESA4 model, and the normalized residual flux with binned averages and a linear trend fit.
figures.validation_check: Checks the Uranus-based IRAM flux calibration by comparing observed Uranus flux with the ESA4 model and testing for secular residual drift.

approx. Uranus flux peak 8.3 Jy near MJD 55000
approx. binned residual near 0 % around MJD 55500
approx. largest negative residual -29 % near MJD 54350
figures.caption_quote: The ESA4 model appears to agree best with the data around 2017.
